data-engineer.description: Use when orchestrating a full ETL pipeline workflow, collecting missing details, coordinating specialist agents, and handling issue, branch, commit, and PR steps directly.

eda.description: Use when analyzing source data, creating eda_{flujo}.py, and producing reporte_eda.json for a new pipeline.

db.description: Use when turning reporte_eda.json into Flyway migrations, attributes.py, schemas.py, and ER artifacts for a pipeline.

etl.description: Use when implementing ETL stages, DAGs, and environment files, then running bootstrap validation until the flow passes or a real external blocker is confirmed.

docs.description: Use when generating or updating a pipeline README from implemented code, migrations, EDA outputs, and environment files.
